newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia yr-on-yr rubber output falls in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia yr-on-yr rubber output falls in Sept.

text.p: Malaysia's year-on-year natural rubber production fell 4.2 percent in September to 97,988 tonnes, the Statistics Department said.
Total output for January to September 1996 dipped 0.7 percent to 796,711 tonnes from 802,152 tonnes in the first nine months of last year, the department said in a report.
On a month-to-month basis, production rose 5.2 percent, or 4,828 tonnes, from the 93,160 tonnes produced in August.
Exports of rubber rose 1.4 percent to 85,284 tonnes during the first nine months of this year compared to the corresponding period last year.
United States was the biggest consumer of Malaysian rubber, taking 12.3 percent of the exports, while South Korea, Germany, Britain and Japan were other major buyers.
